13-radial-dendrogram-edge-bundling.visual_critic_note: Dark palette with deliberate blue/orange source-target contrast and satisfying fade-on-hover interaction, but the dense label ring at 10px is barely legible and the bundled edges at default tension blur together into an undifferentiated mass before hovering.
13-radial-dendrogram-edge-bundling.encoding_integrity_note: Topological encoding is structurally honest (no quantitative scale deception, cluster layout is data-driven), but the tension slider displays 0.85 while actually setting bundle beta to 1−0.85=0.15 (semantic inversion), and data joins lack key functions making permutation robustness untestable.
13-radial-dendrogram-edge-bundling.stress_test_note: The tension slider fires `linkSelection.attr('d', line)` on every `input` event with no debounce or RAF, recalculating all ~80 bundle curves per pixel of drag; no transitions are used so mid-flight snap and stale-scale issues are absent, and there is no cross-view dispatch so infinite loops cannot occur.
13-radial-dendrogram-edge-bundling.cognitive_load_note: 87 leaf nodes and ~80 edges are well-managed by hierarchical bundling (tension=0.85) and low-opacity resting state, but the static center is dense and the 10px rotated labels approach minimum readability — the hover-to-highlight interaction carries most of the cognitive load reduction and can't be assessed from a screenshot.
